# FieldRF

> Anatomy-conditioned 3D rectified flow for within-modality cross-field MRI harmonization. One shared model covers T1W, T2W and T2FLAIR at 0.1T, 1.5T, 3T, 5T and 7T.

Repository: https://github.com/So-cean/FieldRF. Python package: `mrixfields-fieldrf`; import namespace: `fieldrf`. Code license: MIT.

The supplied pipeline generates MAISI latent caches and Brain-ID feature caches, then performs unpaired RF pretraining, endpoint alignment, VAE decoder adaptation and paired RF adaptation. Inference reads both caches and the raw source image grid to produce target-field NIfTI volumes. The official benchmark supplies the data splits. Upstream pretrained weights are downloaded separately; trained FieldRF checkpoints are produced by the training recipe.

## Documentation

- [Reproduction pipeline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/So-cean/FieldRF/main/README.md): Installation, upstream weight downloads, split layout, both cache commands, four training stages, artifact selection and inference.
- [Setup and project questions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/So-cean/FieldRF/main/docs/README.md): Dependencies, cache geometry, preflight checks, checkpoint migration, distributed training, resume and checkpoint choices.
- [FieldRF code guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/So-cean/FieldRF/main/FieldRF/README.md): Module responsibilities, dataset roles and CPU test inventory.
- [Verification record](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/So-cean/FieldRF/main/REPRODUCIBILITY.md): Tested environments, CPU/Gloo DDP and resume tests, short real-data GPU pipeline runs and retained-paper-weight inference checks. Records distinguish these checks from full benchmark reproduction and multi-GPU CUDA/NCCL validation.

- [FieldRF paper](https://papers.miccai.org/miccai-2026-sat/MRIxFields2026_026.html): Author list, abstract and proceedings citation for MICCAI 2026 Workshops and Challenges, LNCS 17274, Springer Nature Switzerland.
- [Paper PDF](https://papers.miccai.org/miccai-2026-sat/paper/MRIxFields2026_026.pdf): Method and experimental results.
- [Citation metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/So-cean/FieldRF/main/CITATION.cff): Preferred conference-paper citation, including authors, venue, volume, publisher and year.
- [Software metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/So-cean/FieldRF/main/codemeta.json): Machine-readable CodeMeta/Schema.org software identity and associated paper.
- [Related project references](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/So-cean/FieldRF/main/REFERENCES.md): MRIxFields2026, MONAI, Brain-ID, MAISI/MAISI-v2 and comparison-method citations.
